profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Software development has been the core of my professional life since before high school.  Throughout that time a central concept and focus has remained: software is about making someone's life easier.  I find my fulfillment in delivering a product to an end user and seeing it simplify their tasks.

This goal has driven my education and interest throughout my career, covering all aspects and areas of software development.  With a primary focus in user interface design, I have also developed experience in software design, database development, application development, requirements management, and software process.  Each of these elements provides a critical piece of a software solution, and a system can only perform as well as its weakest link.

My current emphasis is on usability and agile software processes which leverage heavy user involvement.  Monolithic requirements efforts which isolate and ignore user goals for years of development have proven a failure.  Agile processes may not be the solution, but classic software engineering approaches have had forty years to find a solution, without success.

Specialties: User interface design, usability, object-oriented software design, agile software process, Java, Swing, C#, SQL, automated testing
